items.html: And know that another time I heard from my teacher, may his memory be blessed, in a different manner, which is that the NHY of Arich did not rise and clothe its CHaGaT, for this is AA. Rather, it is like the matter of the rising of the worlds on the day of Sabbath, as explained in its place, see there. And it is found that the CHaGaT of Arich rose first above, in the place of the three Mochin of AVI, and became Mochin for them. And afterward the NHY of Arich rose and rose into the place of the CHaGaT of AA, and clothed there within the CHaGaT of AVI, but not in all of it, so that it is found in the place where they were at the beginning of the three middle sections of the CHaGaT of Arich itself.
